scope: Primary-source research only; no algorithm imported or renderer candidate tested.

sources.author: Dirk Gerrit van Antwerpen
sources.reviewed_scope: Article body: hit reconstruction, RTX error constants, offset, direction/grazing caveat. Automatically generated summary excluded.
sources.finding: Origin bounds do not cover grazing direction-side flips; primitive-ID rejection alone does not cover adjacent triangles.
sources.limit: Does not diagnose Cubey or supply a ready-made dielectric direction correction.

sources.reviewed_scope: Intersection candidate precision, shared-edge/closed-fan watertightness, ray face culling and HitKind.
sources.finding: Facing uses projected ray-space area; watertightness is expressed as should/expected/tested rather than a universal must.
sources.limit: Does not imply this failure is a driver defect or prove any CPU/GPU disagreement.

sources.finding: Triangle front/back kind is available in closest-hit/any-hit, not directly in ray generation.
sources.limit: Current Cubey payload does not carry it; changing the payload requires an instrumented build and fidelity checks.

sources.reviewed_scope: Spawn-point error bounds, fixed epsilon tradeoff, geometry intersection error.
sources.finding: A larger fixed offset can miss nearby geometry.
sources.limit: PBRT software intersection behavior is not an exact model of hardware traversal.

sources.authors: Sven Woop, Carsten Benthin, Ingo Wald
sources.reviewed_scope: Publication abstract and algorithm overview; no equations implemented.
sources.finding: Robust shared-edge/vertex tests require more than blindly promoting a basic intersection formula to double.
sources.limit: A diagnostic reference, not a proposal to replace hardware traversal.
